sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: Guardian fashion expert Melanie Wilkinson advised you on your wardrobe, replying to queries about clothes and footwear for both men and women bisqof asks: When do you anticipate my Uzbek hat is going to be in? Mel: ​As luck would have it, statement hats are a huge trend for the autumn! So it’s the perfect time to dust it off. Mel: Boden have a wide range of sizes in tailoring (from UK4 - 22) and the quality is excellent - I like this pinstripe style. It’s not super cheap, but more affordable than other specialist brands and it will last. The Fold is also one of my go-to’s. It’s bit too pricey at full whack, but have a look when they are on sale. I think this jacket with matching trousers is worth it for such a gorgeous colour. Continue reading...
